description: This file defines a template class 'Client' for WebSocket communication, including connection management functions and logging. It appears to be part of a WebSocket client implementation with support for encrypted and unencrypted connections.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: A template class for managing WebSocket client connections, supporting both encrypted and unencrypted protocols, with methods for connecting and disconnecting.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to the specified address, setting up callbacks for connection initialization and closure.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection and logs the disconnection event.
